senses.gloss:
गृद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, desirous of, eagerly longing
for; [cf. Old Germ. gir, kir: Mod. Germ. gier:
Eng. greedy (?): Goth. gredags, gaurs: Hib.
greadaim, ‘I burn;’ greadhnach, ‘joyful, glad;’
gradh, ‘love, charity; dear;’ graidhneog, ‘a be-
loved female,’ &c.: Lith. godus, gedu: Slav. glad,
‘hunger.’]
